name: Pobeg iz Rodnika
source:
One videoblogger with anonymous operator try to escape from mysterious creature, which has released very creepy sounds on Wotersource. This novel is a mix of pretty dramatic plot, that will make you think about our lifes and destinies, and various popular Russian memes with local developer's jokes.
This is the continue of this story: https://youtu.be/0d2aMsvXR6I
translation:
一名视频博主与匿名操作者试图逃离神秘生物，而这种生物在Wotersource上释放了非常可怕的声音。本作将颇具戏剧性的剧情与各种流行俄罗斯网络梗、当地开发者的笑话结合起来，会让你思考我们的人生与命运。

这是以下故事的续篇：https://youtu.be/0d2aMsvXR6I
